objective: Gate 8E R3-R3. Auditar metadata no secreta de dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig para determinar config/provider/template canonicos reutilizables para Catalogo Ampliado EMAIL/WHATSAPP. Corregir definitivamente el fallo por JSON legacy: nunca llamar JSON_VALUE directamente sobre PayloadMongo; primero envolverlo en CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN PayloadMongo ELSE '{}' END. Sin secretos, destinatarios, template_texto, DML, DDL, envios ni Produccion.

queries.name: readonly_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: notification_config_json_health
queries.sql: SELECT Activo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EsJsonValido,COUNT_BIG(*) AS cantidad FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig GROUP BY Activo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY Activo,EsJsonValido

queries.name: notification_metadata_sanitized
queries.sql: WITH S AS (SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN PayloadMongo ELSE '{}' END AS J FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig) SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.id') AS payload_id,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.canal') AS canal,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.modulo') AS modulo,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.evento') AS evento,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.provider') AS provider,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.modo_envio') AS modo_envio,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.template_codigo') AS template_codigo,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.codigo') AS codigo,CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(J,'$.template_texto') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tiene_template_texto FROM S WHERE Activo=1 ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,Id

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_config_candidates
queries.sql: WITH S AS (SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN PayloadMongo ELSE '{}' END AS J FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig) SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.canal') AS canal,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.modulo') AS modulo,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.evento') AS evento,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.provider') AS provider,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.modo_envio') AS modo_envio,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.template_codigo') AS template_codigo,JSON_VALUE(J,'$.codigo') AS codigo,CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(J,'$.template_texto') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tiene_template_texto FROM S WHERE Activo=1 AND (LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(J,'$.modulo'),'')) IN ('catalogo_ampliado','catalogo ampliado') OR LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(J,'$.evento'),'')) LIKE '%vencim%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(J,'$.codigo'),'')) LIKE '%vencim%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(JSON_VALUE(J,'$.codigo'),'')) LIKE '%catalog%') ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,Id

constraints: Do not return template_texto content, only whether it exists
JSON_VALUE must receive only CASE-sanitized valid JSON
